notes: Summary: HelmBridge builds a dev-focused knowledge product (internal code & docs search) — high cardinality corpus (code, PRs, design docs). Primary ask: accurate reranking + low cost at scale.
Corpus scale: expecting 20M - 60M embeddings over 12 months; initial POC 1M vectors from two repos and internal KB.
Reindex cadence: nightly full-ish pipelines with frequent incremental reindex (hourly deltas for active repos). Concern: ingestion window and KV cache invalidation impact on latency.
Latency targets: 95th percentile end-to-end (embedding match + rerank) <= 150ms for most interactive flows; background batch jobs can be slower.
Cost sensitivity: cost-per-query target ~<$0.01 (strict) for large scale; they want batching/quantization guidance to meet target.

Model preferences: open-model friendly, want ability to route to smaller reranker models for low-cost flows and fall back to larger models for high-value queries. Asked about Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization/profile selection.
Security: strict SAML mapping (group->role) for developer access; must support SCIM provisioning (requested). Audit logging retention 1 year minimum for search events.
Integration: primary code host = self-hosted GitLab; want Connector guidance (polling vs event-driven) and examples for incremental vector upserts + tombstones.
Quotes: 'We care about predictability — we can't have nightly reindexes break latency during business hours.' — Head of Platform (paraphrased).
POC success criteria (agreed): ingest 1M vectors in <8 hours, support 100 QPS sustained with <=150ms p95 for search+rerank, cost model doc that projects 12-month spend with chosen config.
